news.raw_snippet: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is moving toward going public on Wall Street, the latest chapter in its meteoric rise from a little-known research laboratory to one of the leading AI companies valued at $965 billion. Anthropic said Monday it has submitted a confidential filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed initial public offering of its common stock. Anthropic said last week it had raised $65 billion in private funding that will push its valuation to $965 billion, a whopping number that makes the five-year-old maker of the Claude chatbot one of the world’s most valuable startups. As for bubble concerns, Law, who rode the dot-com IPO wave while working for internet company VerticalNet in the early part of the century, said there’s evidence from these AI startups’ existing products to show they are on a path not just to profitability but to artificial general intelligence, technology that does work as well as or better than humans.

news.title: AI大规模市值重估（Mark-to-Market）
news.snippet: 经过多年私募市场高估值融资后，AI公司正面临按市值计价的估值调整压力，公开市场对AI资产的定价更为审慎。
news.raw_snippet: # The Great AI Mark-to-Market. ### After years of private-market mythology, public markets are about to ask for receipts. The IPO window is reopening and Wall Street is about to become the world's largest AI benchmark. SpaceX is preparing to go public. If even some of the rumored valuations hold, public markets will soon be asked to absorb trillions of dollars of new market cap from companies that, until now, have mostly been priced by private-market consensus, strategic necessity, and vibes. It is tempting to put it in the AI bucket because Elon Musk is involved and xAI is somewhere in the family photo, but SpaceX is mostly not a model lab. This is a company that owns bottlenecks. But if it is the infrastructure monopoly for launch, satellite broadband, defense connectivity, orbital logistics, and future space-based industry, the valuation becomes a call option on markets that are still being formed. The public market used to be where companies went to raise money.

news.title: ROI优先：投资能自负盈亏的AI
news.snippet: AI不再是未来技术，企业应优先部署能快速产生投资回报率（ROI）的实用AI解决方案，而非仅仅追求技术先进性。
news.raw_snippet: Artificial intelligence is no longer a technology of the future; it has rapidly become a foundational pillar of today’s business operations. According to a recent survey, organizations are shifting away from viewing AI as a cost‑efficiency tool and are increasingly recognizing it as an engine of growth. In fact, nearly three‑quarters of IT and industry leaders now say revenue growth, not cost savings, is the primary objective of their AI initiatives. As adoption accelerates, the CFO’s role has evolved from financial steward to strategic architect, ensuring every AI investment is grounded in measurable business value. In this environment, CFOs must become vigilant of both capital and innovation, balancing the allure of emerging technologies with the necessity for measurable outcomes. The “ROI First” mindset, paired with disciplined guardrails and a deep understanding of technology, empowers financial leaders to fund innovation that pays for itself, now and into the future.
